ma.saveFile(Object object)

Save files to a local path. Note: saveFile moves temporary files. Therefore, after the API is called successfully, the input tempFilePath is unavailable.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
tempFilePath String Yes Temporary path (local path) for saving files.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String saveFile: ok
savedFilePath String File path for saving files (local path).

Sample Code

ma.chooseImage({
  success: function (res) {
    const tempFilePaths = res.tempFilePaths;
    ma.saveFile({
      tempFilePath: tempFilePaths[0],
      success(res) {
        const savedFilePath = res.savedFilePath;
      }
    });
  }
});

Tips

  1. Support calling through FileSystemManager
